pages.title: Catch Them All
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Match identical items to clear space and catch cats in Catch Them All. Look for combinations that help you finish the board and reach more of the cats.

pages.title: Detective Ava: Logic Files
pages.creator: Fantasy Realm
pages.description: Read clues and sort suspects by whether they could have committed the crime in Detective Ava: Logic Files. Use a hint if the evidence in one of the 90 cases leaves you stuck.

pages.title: Mahjong Solitaire: Tile Blast
pages.creator: EmotGame
pages.description: Clear pairs of identical available tiles in Mahjong Solitaire: Tile Blast. Check which tiles a pair will expose before removing it, and use boosters or hints on harder layouts.

pages.title: Ocean Bubble Sort
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Move colors between bottles in Ocean Bubble Sort. Keep an empty space available until you can group each color together, and unlock new themes as you solve more layouts.

pages.title: Jewels Coloring Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Fill a picture with gems in Jewels Coloring Puzzle. Check the number and color for each section before placing the jewels, and build the design one area at a time.

pages.title: Asylum: Baldi Granny Slender
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Search a forest and its asylum for rare figurines in Asylum: Baldi Granny Slender. Look for places to hide when Granny, Baldi, Slenderman, or the roaming deer gets close.

pages.title: Archery Master - Bow and Arrow
pages.creator: takemesomewherenice
pages.description: Pick a bow and aim for the bullseye in Archery Master - Bow and Arrow. Judge each shot and work on your accuracy as you take on other archers.

pages.title: Color Yarn Sort
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Send yarn spools into matching buckets in Color Yarn Sort. Think about which bucket to bring forward next, since there is only so much room to hold them.

pages.title: Brainrot-A Difference Challenge
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Spot small changes between pairs of Italian Brainrot pictures in Brainrot-A Difference Challenge. Compare the edges of characters and check the background as you work through each photo puzzle.

pages.title: Commando Force 2
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description: Fight through different maps in Commando Force 2. Use WASD to move, R to reload, and the number keys to switch weapons. Unlock more gear as you play.

pages.title: Plane Chase
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Chase an aircraft from the ground in Plane Chase. Accelerate your car and try to close the gap to the plane as it pulls away into the air.

pages.title: Sudoku Guru - classic sudoku
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Place digits so each row, column, and box in Sudoku Guru - classic sudoku has one of each number. Choose from five difficulties or take on a daily challenge.

pages.title: Noob Shooter: Gun Battle 3D
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Join your squad in Noob Shooter: Gun Battle 3D and try to get more eliminations than the other team. Work around the other fighters as you look for targets.

pages.title: Cars Derby Arena
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Customize a car for destruction in Cars Derby Arena. Improve its performance and experiment with changes to the gravity and weather as you put it through the derby.

pages.title: Turret Gunner
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Track enemy targets in Turret Gunner. Maneuver in the air and fire as opponents move into view, then line up the next target as the battle continues.

pages.title: Build A Rich Queen
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Swipe a credit card at payment terminals in Build A Rich Queen to pick up clothes and accessories. Choose which upgrades to buy as you move toward the obstacles ahead.

pages.title: Screw Jam!
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description: Remove screws and collect them in the right boxes in Screw Jam! Check the screw colors and choose which fasteners to loosen to finish every set.

pages.title: Stickman Prison Escape
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Try to get Stickman out of jail in Stickman Prison Escape. Choose among three items hidden inside a Halloween pumpkin and see which one gets him past the guards.

pages.title: Mermaidcore Makeup
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Create underwater-inspired looks for three characters in Mermaidcore Makeup. Try the makeup on each face and see how the colors work together before moving on to the next.

pages.title: Idle Factory Domination
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Buy plots and start production in Idle Factory Domination. Invest in businesses and resources, then use their output to grow your operation and open more territory.

pages.title: Soft Girls Winter Aesthetics
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Pick outfits for a winter trip in Soft Girls Winter Aesthetics. Help the princesses dress for the activities at each stop and build looks around the different destinations.

pages.title: Eating Simulator
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Click to eat and grow in Eating Simulator. Sell food so you can level up and buy upgrades, then use your progress to work toward an even larger character.

pages.title: Ragdoll Down
pages.creator: Harbi Games
pages.description: Send a ragdoll into hazards in Ragdoll Down. Try the objects and surfaces in each setup and see how the collisions affect the damage total. Find more items in the shop.

pages.title: Ellie and Friends Pre Fall Outfit
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Put together outfits for the start of fall in Ellie and Friends Pre Fall Outfit. Try layers and accessories in seasonal shades and give each friend a look of her own.

pages.title: Smackem All
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Drag left and right in Smackem All to line up a target. Take out the opponents in front of you and move between them until you've cleared the group.

pages.title: Koala Coloring Pages
pages.creator: mapacarta
pages.description: Color koalas climbing trees, sleeping, or eating eucalyptus in Koala Coloring Pages. Pick a design and use the virtual tools to paint it, then save or share the finished picture.

pages.title: Dig This
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Carve paths through dirt in Dig This and use gravity to guide objects through each puzzle. Think about where things will roll before you dig away the ground beneath them.

pages.title: K Game Glass Bridge Survival
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Remember the safe route in K Game Glass Bridge Survival. Use what the game shows you to pick each landing, then jump across the correct glass panels to the finish.

pages.title: Danger Dash
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description: Swipe past obstacles in Danger Dash. Keep the runner moving through the jungle, lost city, and temple as the route changes. Watch the path ahead so you can react in time.

pages.title: 3D Touch
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Trace a route through every cube in 3D Touch. Tap the cubes in order and plan ahead because you can't go back. Collect coins for new skins as you progress.

pages.title: Leap Parking
pages.creator: Nanjing maileyou Network Technology Co., Ltd
pages.description: Aim a car toward its parking spot in Leap Parking. Set the strength and direction, pick up yellow stars where you can, and use the gold you earn for upgrades.

pages.title: Millionaire Trivia Quiz
pages.creator: AppyApp
pages.description: Answer questions for a chance at a virtual million in Millionaire Trivia Quiz. Read each prompt and choose the answer you think is right as you work up the prize ladder.

pages.title: Mahjong Blitz
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Remove matching pairs in Mahjong Blitz. Look for tiles with a side open and decide which match will expose the most useful pieces. Clear every tile to finish.

pages.title: zBall 3 Football
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Keep a football on narrow platforms in zBall 3 Football. Turn at the crossings and collect flags to raise your score and buy your favorite team.

pages.title: Horse Racing 2D
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Choose a horse in Horse Racing 2D and manage its stamina through the race. Time when to use your speed, try different breeds, and see which horse finishes first.

pages.title: Popit vs Spinner
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Clear groups of matching pieces in Popit vs Spinner. Remove two or more of a kind and use the spinner to create another set of matches when you run out.

pages.title: Skateboard Master
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Guide a skateboarder with the mouse in Skateboard Master. Adjust your direction as the course changes and work through the different level layouts without losing control.

pages.title: Drift Race 3D
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Hold to turn right and release to turn left in Drift Race 3D. Time those changes to stay on the road and keep ahead of the other racers.

pages.title: VIP Slot Machine
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Set your virtual bet and paylines in VIP Slot Machine, then spin the reels. Watch for wild symbols, free spins, and bonus rounds as you play.

pages.title: Fisherman Sliding Puzzles
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Slide pieces to match the reference image in Fisherman Sliding Puzzles. Check the finished picture on the right as you reconstruct each of the eight fishing scenes.

pages.title: Car Traffic 2D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Steer through traffic with the arrow keys in Car Traffic 2D. Pick up cash and power-ups where you have a safe approach, then keep driving to finish the track.

pages.title: Totem Volcano
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Bring the totem down safely in Totem Volcano. Tap blocks in the right order, watching how the stack shifts when you remove its supports.

pages.title: Jelly World
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Click to jump in Jelly World and reach the diamonds in the air. Look for useful pickups as you take off, and time your moves to get across the course.

pages.title: Halloween Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick one of four scenes in Halloween Coloring Book. Color a witch, cats, or pumpkin lanterns with your own palette, then try a different illustration.

pages.title: Military Shooter Training
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Practice your aim in Military Shooter Training. Line up the shot before firing and adjust between attempts as you work through the game's marksmanship exercises.

pages.title: Scratch & Guess Celebrities
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Reveal enough of a portrait to identify the person in Scratch & Guess Celebrities. Use the scratch meter to judge how much you can uncover before making your guess.

pages.title: Mahjong Sunset
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Clear matching tiles in Mahjong Sunset. Use pieces that can slide out to the left or right, and replay any of the sixteen unlocked layouts to improve your time.

pages.title: PillowBattle.io
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Grab the pillow before the other players in PillowBattle.io. Dodge incoming swings and choose when to attack, then try to stay in the match until everyone else is out.

pages.title: Off Road Mountain Jeep Drive 2020
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Drive a jeep across steep hills and rivers in Off Road Mountain Jeep Drive 2020. Use the arrow keys and brake with space as you approach logs and other obstacles.

pages.title: Parking Jam Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Slide cars out of a crowded lot in Parking Jam Online. Choose vehicles with an open route first, then use the space they leave to free the blocked cars.

pages.title: Police Drift Car
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Take a police car through city streets in Police Drift Car. Practice slides and try stunts around the city as you work through the driving missions.

pages.title: Spin Wheel Earn Cod Points
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Start the spinner in Spin Wheel Earn Cod Points. Watch the wheel slow down and read the result under its pointer when it comes to rest.

pages.title: Water Car Racing
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Race fast cars on water-covered tracks in Water Car Racing. Watch for obstacles on the course and steer around them as you work to stay ahead.

pages.title: Broken Bridge Car Driving
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drive across damaged spans in Broken Bridge Car Driving. Use WASD to steer and line up each crossing before continuing. Try different cars on the later levels.

pages.title: Poly Puzzles 3D
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Rotate a cluster of fragments in Poly Puzzles 3D. Change your viewing angle until the pieces come together as a recognizable image, then move on to another artwork.

pages.title: HelixJump.io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Rotate the helix in HelixJump.io to let the ball drop through the gaps. Find openings below the bounce and avoid the red tiles as you descend.

pages.title: Cartoon Pigeon Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Reassemble colorful bird pictures in Cartoon Pigeon Jigsaw. Choose from three modes and move the pieces into place using feather colors and outlines as clues.

pages.title: SpaceGuard.io
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fight across sci-fi arenas in SpaceGuard.io. Use portals and jump pads to move between parts of the map, and play solo Deathmatch or team battles.

pages.title: Police Drift Car Driving Stunt Game
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Roam the city in a police car in Police Drift Car Driving Stunt Game. Look for places to drift or attempt stunts, then adjust the speed and approach as you drive.

pages.title: Lovely Christmas Toys Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Build jigsaws of holiday toys in Lovely Christmas Toys Puzzle. Pick one of six pictures and choose 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces.

pages.title: Block Hexa Merge 2048
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Merge four or more equal numbers in Block Hexa Merge 2048. Shift blocking pieces out of the way so you can bring the values together and form a larger number.

pages.title: Garbage Truck City Simulator
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Collect waste at city stops in Garbage Truck City Simulator and take it to the drop-off. Use WASD or the arrows to drive between locations.

pages.title: Popcorn Burst
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Hold the mouse to dispense popcorn in Popcorn Burst. Fill the bucket without spilling any pieces, and judge when to release as the shape of the setup changes.

pages.title: Dangerous Racing
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Dodge obstacles and collect fuel, lives, and coins in Dangerous Racing. Keep an eye on the fuel supply and steer toward pickups that let you stay on the road.

pages.title: Tiles Hop 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Drag the ball from tile to tile in Tiles Hop 3D. Use the beat to time your moves and stay on the route as each song sets its own rhythm.

pages.title: Halloween Blast
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Connect at least three matching masks in Halloween Blast. Look for larger groups as the timer runs and try to score enough points to advance.

pages.title: Stunt Bike
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Ride a trials bike across twenty city courses in Stunt Bike. Cross gaps, take routes over rooftops, and watch for traffic when the course brings you back to street level.

pages.title: Kids Classroom Decoration
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Redesign a room for students in Kids Classroom Decoration. Choose a chalkboard, flooring, and furnishings, then see how the colors and furniture look in the classroom.

pages.title: Xtreme Trials Bike 2019
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Ride a cross bike through forest obstacles in Xtreme Trials Bike 2019. Try to beat your time, and use checkpoints to keep your progress when a jump goes wrong.

pages.title: Super Boxing Fight Night
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Throw jabs and crosses in Super Boxing Fight Night. Block with your gloves when your opponent attacks and link punches to earn power-ups before the next exchange.

pages.title: Motorcycles Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Piece together motorcycle pictures in Motorcycles Puzzle. Pick from six images and four piece counts, then use details in the frame and wheels to fit the sections together.

pages.title: Chota Rajini
pages.creator: Mobi2Fun
pages.description: Swipe up to jump and down to slide in Chota Rajini. Watch where the next obstacle sits and choose the move that lets you get past it.

pages.title: Rocket Clash 3D
pages.creator: Freeway Interactive
pages.description: Fight for a missile base in Rocket Clash 3D. Lead the resistance in team combat and use weapons such as the shortened AK to push back the opposing squad.

pages.title: EG Girl Football
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Head the ball toward the opposing goal in EG Girl Football. Cover your side when the ball comes back and adjust to faster play as the match continues.

pages.title: Kids Math Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Solve addition and subtraction problems in Kids Math Challenge. Click or tap to give your answers and see how many you can get right for a higher score.

pages.title: Slendrina Must Die The School
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search for eight fuses in Slendrina Must Die The School. Use them to open the special classroom, and look for the teddy bear while defending yourself inside the school.

pages.title: Gold Seeker
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Go after gold and gemstones in Gold Seeker. Time the miner's hook to grab a valuable piece and use dynamite when a catch gets in the way.

pages.title: Goat to the Moon
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Help a goat fly toward the moon in Goat to the Moon. Take off with its jetpack and guide it upward so it can reach what it thinks is a giant piece of cheese.

pages.title: Halloween Slide Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Slide pieces to work the gold toward the exit in Halloween Slide Puzzle. Look for a free route and choose what to move first before the layout gets more difficult.

pages.title: Christmas Factory
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Manage Santa's elves in Christmas Factory and keep toys moving through the workshop. Get presents made and wrapped in time for Christmas night.

pages.title: Domestic Animal Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick a difficulty in Domestic Animal Memory Challenge and turn over pictures to find identical animals. Remember where each one is so you can return to it when its match appears.

pages.title: Check3
pages.creator: RidM
pages.description: Put three checks in each row and column in Check3. Keep checks from touching horizontally or vertically and use crosses to mark squares that can't take one.

pages.title: Amigo Pancho 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear a path for Amigo's balloons in Amigo Pancho 2. Click objects to remove them, and think about what might pop a balloon before you set the next obstacle in motion.

pages.title: Stick Soldier
pages.creator: Gaming Club
pages.description: Hold to build a bridge in Stick Soldier, then release to let the soldier cross. Judge the distance to the next pole so the bridge reaches it.

pages.title: Adam and Eve: Golf
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Take Adam through a prehistoric golf course in Adam and Eve: Golf. Aim each shot toward the hole and use the terrain to judge how much power you'll need.

pages.title: Princesses Boho Beachwear Obsession
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Dress Elsa, Belle, and Jasmine for the beach in Princesses Boho Beachwear Obsession. Try colorful swimsuits, sheer cover-ups, and statement jewelry for each princess.

pages.title: Ice Queen Realife Shopping
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Collect bills before heading to the mall in Ice Queen Realife Shopping. Try dresses, separates, shoes, and bags, and decide what to buy with the money you've gathered.

pages.title: New Spring Wardrobe 2
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Give Lara a spring look in New Spring Wardrobe 2. Shop for clothes, then choose makeup and accessories that work with the outfit you put together.

pages.title: Girl on Skates: Paper Blaze
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Print and deliver newspapers in Girl on Skates: Paper Blaze. Collect stacks for delivery and skate through the streets to get the papers where they need to go.

pages.title: Super Market Cashier Girl
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Choose work uniforms for three employees in Super Market Cashier Girl. Try different clothing and colors, then fit an apron that goes with each cashier's outfit.
